name: Super Tennis Breakout
detailed_description:
Super Tennis Breakout

This game is currently in early development and began as a project during Unreal Fellowship 2025.

Tennis meets brick-breaking chaos in a neon-fueled arcade future.

Super Tennis Breakout blends the fast-paced fun of arcade tennis with the explosive thrills of classic breakout gameplay, all driven by dynamic physics. Smash through reactive block formations in a vibrant, retro-futuristic arena where every hit brings satisfying destruction.

🎾 A New Kind of Rally

This isn't just about keeping the ball in play. In Super Tennis Breakout, both the ball and the blocks follow physics-based movement, creating unpredictable bounces, wild chain reactions, and nonstop arcade action. Simple to pick up, wild to master.

🔥 Game Modes:

  • Classic Mode: A continuous challenge where block patterns evolve and the difficulty ramps up the longer you survive

  • Beat The Wall: A relentless wall slowly pushes waves of blocks toward you. Clear them fast or get crushed under the pressure

  • Endless Chaos: Waves of physics-driven blocks fall from above in unpredictable patterns. Stay in control or get buried in rising madness

🛠 Features:

  • Tennis Arcade Action: Fast rallies, reactive ball physics, and energetic movement mixed with breakout-style block destruction

  • Full Physics Gameplay: Both the ball and the blocks react to speed, angle, and impact, making each match unpredictable and fun to master

  • Futuristic Arena: Compete across neon-lit court filled with animated hazards, obstacles, and ever-changing block layouts

  • Power-Ups Galore: Unleash chaos with effects like multi-ball, explosive ball, size boosts, size reductions, mystery power-ups, and more

  • Retro Synth Soundtrack: A punchy, nostalgic audio experience featuring 12 synthwave tracks that power the pace and neon glow of every match

🪐 The Court Has Changed

Whether you're racing against a creeping wall, fending off a falling wave of bricks, or smashing for the high score, Super Tennis Breakout serves up fast, physics-fueled fun with a nostalgic arcade soul. Pick up your racket and break everything

Powered by Unreal Engine

short_description: A fast-paced arcade tennis-breakout hybrid with physics-driven chaos. Smash blocks, trigger wild power-ups, face falling blocks, advancing walls, and evolving challenges. Built in Unreal Engine during Unreal Fellowship 2025, Super Tennis Breakout is fast, local, and full of retro-futuristic flair.
